Function HexText(ByVal value As String) As String
Dim i As Long
For i=1 To Len(value)
HexText=HexText & Right$("0000" & Hex$(AscW(Mid$(value,i,1)) And &HFFFF&),4)
Next
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim r As Long,c As Long
For r=1 To 14
For c=1 To 2
Snapshot=Snapshot & CStr(r) & ":" & CStr(c) & ":" & HexText(CStr(Cells(r,c).Value2)) & ":" & HexText(CStr(Cells(r,c).Formula)) & ";"
Next
Next
End Function
